correctness.rationale: Avoidance is factorial, so exhaustive binary prefix extension is complete. On appending a bit, every new instance must be a suffix. Splitting every suffix of length 3m into equal blocks A,B,C and testing B,C against A and its reversal is exactly the definition of an undirected instance of the unary cube pattern. The exact level counts are 1,2,4,6,10,16,18,12,10,6,0 through length 10. A separate whole-factor scan rechecks all six length-9 boundary words, and an exact symmetry computation gives orbit sizes 2 and 4.
